results.requirementReference: REQ-OPC-016 AC-1, AC-4, AC-5; REQ-OPC-017 AC-1, AC-4; REQ-OPC-039 AC-4

steps.action: As `ADMIN_ALL`, create RUN-NAME (Egypt, Egyptian Pound, remarks) with Approve

steps.actual: Passed — every action and assertion in this step succeeded.

steps.action: Find RUN-NAME-2 in the default (Active) list

steps.actual: Passed — every action and assertion in this step succeeded.
